support_spans: a 15 × 6 cm cystic mass with regular margins was found arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex
concepts.why: The presence of a large cystic mass with regular margins arising from the right tubo-ovarian complex could suggest a dermoid cyst, but the presence of purulent fluid is unusual for this condition.

The negative urine human chorionic gonadotropin test helps to rule out ectopic pregnancy, but given the clinical presentation, it is still a consideration that needs to be evaluated in the context of other findings.
The negative HIV testing is relevant in considering the risk of opportunistic infections such as pelvic tuberculosis, especially in a patient presenting with abdominal pain and a cystic mass.
